scope: Independent adversarial review of whether the current eight-page Intel thesis supports a decision-useful 3-5-year SHORT. Only this new JSON is written; no PDF, source or operating-policy edits.
artifact_read: All eight PDF pages directly extracted and read; PDF SHA256 ecb9b36b4c7f1b57597ad6246439c766b4445f0035609530cecd83c5f5762796.

verdict.prior_judgment_preserved: A defensible valuation-led, risk-adjusted-underperformance SHORT is logically possible and compatible with the published M37 framing. The operating and risk judgments have real support. Rising conditional future intrinsic value does not refute that view.
verdict.remaining_weakness: The PDF does not yet choose and substantiate the economic criterion that makes SHORT preferable as a position. The central path supports a low-return long valuation concern; its terminal values do not establish an attractive outright short held through 2030. The underperformance label by itself does not fill that gap.
verdict.not_a_contradiction: This is incomplete position underwriting, not proof that LONG is correct or that M37 requires positive unhedged profit in every case.
verdict.confidence: Moderate conviction in the conditional negative valuation judgment. Incomplete evidence for an attractive outright 3-5-year short under the frozen forecasts. Confidence in these statements is different from probability that the stock falls or the pitch wins.
verdict.recommended_position_on_revision: Keep the qualified SHORT view if the author still owns the operating/risk judgment, but explicitly distinguish valuation conviction from position-return evidence. Adding a caution sentence is disclosure, not a substantive repair.

official_rules.published: Intel or SpaceX; long or short; 3-5-year investment horizon; fundamental analysis; clear initial recommendation with drivers and risks. Round 2 adds valuation, evidence and enough quantitative analysis. Judgment is emphasized over modeling skills.
official_rules.boundary: The rules do not prohibit relative-underperformance framing. They also do not declare that relative underperformance alone is an adequate investment case. Framing compatibility is not economic validation.

central_concept.negative_alpha_vs_short_profit: A stock can have positive absolute return and negative risk-adjusted return. That can make it a legitimate short leg in a portfolio, without making a standalone short profitable.
central_concept.CFA_scope: Jensen alpha compares return with a market-risk-based required return; the source also cautions about benchmark choice, beta instability and omitted idiosyncratic risk. These are measurement concepts, not a forecast of Intel alpha.
central_concept.asset_vs_equity_warning: The 11.555% operating discount rate is not the expected return on the common stock or a margined short. Subtracting the stock-price CAGR from that rate does not independently calculate alpha.
central_concept.conditional_vs_expected_warning: Scenario intrinsic values are not expected terminal market prices. A payoff diagnostic treating them as cover prices also assumes valuation convergence at that endpoint. No guaranteed catalyst is demanded, but this assumption must remain visible.

repair_options.can_do: Put financing on the same horizon as the chosen cover scenario and show sensitivity. It can materially change the three-year boundary.
repair_options.cannot_do: Use the 4.94% Treasury valuation input as an earned short rebate; ignore stock-loan costs, tier blending, marked collateral, dividend obligations or account capital treatment.
repair_options.finding: Corrected central break-even is 3.0846% net per year to end-2029 and 4.8569% to end-2030 in the fixed-initial-proceeds approximation. Current posted IBKR Pro marginal USD short-proceeds rates top out at 3.630% before stock-loan fees. Substituting these posted rates does not rescue the four-year central case in that approximation. Actual marked-collateral and institutional arrangements require separate treatment; no exact broker-account payoff is asserted.
repair_options.status: Useful diagnostic; not a stand-alone repair.

repair_options.can_do: Change the selected forecast if independently stronger evidence supports lower CPU unit/mix realization, slower capacity delivery, or weaker retained profits. Preserve simultaneous capex and working-capital responses.
repair_options.cannot_do: Promote the weak scenario because its terminal price falls below entry. Neither the published market-growth arithmetic nor a speculative downside path identifies an exact expected operating forecast.
repair_options.finding: The existing weaker scenario is plausible as a stress and has passed arithmetic review. The current review supplies no new business evidence sufficient to designate it the central expectation. The low-mature-margin/low-capital-productivity case alone still has an end-2030 conditional value around $60.20.
repair_options.status: Potentially substantive, but not justified by this review and not adopted.

repair_options.can_do: Expose the downside likelihood needed to overcome the central and favorable cases. If the author owns economically justified probabilities, calculate both expected payoff and loss asymmetry.
repair_options.cannot_do: Assign neat bear/base/bull weights to make an expected target attractive; treat the existing controls as mutually exclusive exhaustive states; average current values and call the result expected 2030 trading profit.
repair_options.finding: Break-even weight boundaries can be calculated without inventing probabilities. They show why optimistic core economics and risk maturation matter. The calculations below do not select weights or establish expected returns.
repair_options.status: Best immediate diagnostic for an outright short; a weighted recommendation still needs a substantive probability judgment.

repair_options.can_do: State whether the economic objective is relative to cash, a broad equity benchmark, a factor exposure or a selected long. Then show the conditional relative-return boundary, net costs and the strongest opposing joint outcome. A hedge is one implementation, not a formal contest requirement.
repair_options.cannot_do: Rename low standalone returns as alpha, assume the benchmark earns a convenient return, treat asset beta as a unique trading hedge, or add benchmark gains while also spending the same short proceeds twice.
repair_options.finding: This route preserves the existing fundamental forecast and is the most natural repair if the intended idea is a short leg in a long-short portfolio. It remains incomplete until the comparator and economic exposure are defined and defended. No exact hedge model is demanded merely for M37 eligibility.
repair_options.status: Valid substantive route if actually underwritten; wording alone is not the repair.

immediate_recommendation.action: Add a compact horizon decision table using frozen cases, not a new selected forecast. Separate the fundamental judgment from the position-selection conclusion.
sequence: State the intended investment objective: standalone short profit or a portfolio-relative short contribution.
Use end-2029 as a legitimate three-year diagnostic and end-2030 as a longer-horizon control; explain timing through the cash recovery rather than selecting the date only because the result improves.
Show conditional weak, central and favorable cover prices with costs or comparative-return hurdles. Preserve the convergence assumption.
For an outright short, show probability break-even boundaries before claiming an expected payoff; adopt weights only with an owned business justification.
For a relative short, define the comparator and exposure and show how much relative performance is needed after costs; keep benchmark return as an explicit assumption or hurdle.
State the resulting decision. If the evidence does not choose between the profitable and unprofitable regions, retain a qualified valuation view and admit the position case remains incomplete.
immediate_recommendation.what_can_be_fixed_now: The payoff map, stale carry arithmetic, horizon sensitivity, and the distinction between valuation conviction and trade conviction.
immediate_recommendation.what_cannot_be_fixed_by_presentation: The expected outcome distribution, future financing terms, future market valuation/convergence, or the economic attractiveness of a strategy whose selected conditions are not yet supported.
immediate_recommendation.early_exit_boundary: Ordinary value-based covering can be sensible if the market converges earlier. Do not rescue the pitch by asserting a convenient early $47 cover price or guaranteeing that convergence occurs before intrinsic value accretes. Published rules do not supply such a timing guarantee.
immediate_recommendation.most_important_concrete_repair: Put the favorable case on the same 2029/2030 horizon as the central and weak cases. PDF page 7 currently omits that horizon outcome while page 5 shows $60.90 at end-2026. The frozen favorable-core plus maturing-risk values are $83.51 in 2029 and $92.58 in 2030. The present valuation chart is not a horizon short-payoff chart.

diagnostic_method.short_cash_formula: PnL = P0 * (1+q)^T - P_cover. q is a hypothetical constant aggregate net yield on initial short proceeds after stock-loan and program spread; it is not an observed INTC financing quote or an account return.
diagnostic_method.three_outcome_probability_formula: Let pW and pB be weak and favorable outcome weights and pC = 1-pW-pB. Break-even requires pW >= [Pcentral - P0*(1+q)^T] / [Pcentral-Pweak] + pB * [Pbull-Pcentral] / [Pcentral-Pweak]. These algebraic weights must also be nonnegative and sum to one.
limits: The chosen three states are illustrations, not an exhaustive distribution or bounded upside loss.
Terminal market cover is assumed equal to each scenario intrinsic value solely for this diagnostic.
No dividend is assumed, matching retained-cash paths; introducing dividends requires jointly adjusting terminal retained cash and short payments.
q is a simplification: actual borrow fees and rebates can apply to marked collateral and change through time.
Posted-capital return, margin/collateral treatment and capital opportunity cost require a separate consistent account comparison; no return on committed capital is claimed.
The favorable core case excludes an additional merchant-wafer option, so it is not a maximum loss bound.
A mathematically negative probability intercept simply means financing alone exceeds the central cover value under that control; it is not a probability recommendation.

primary_broker_check.source_mechanics: Borrow fees and proceeds interest are distinct components. Rates depend on program and arrangement and are subject to change; borrowing costs can exceed interest.
primary_broker_check.application_limit: Not an INTC borrow quote, not M37 terms, not a forecast over 2029-2030. Tier rates are marginal, not automatically the blended rate on the entire balance.
